text.style: font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;font-weight:bold;font-stretch:normal;font-size:5.31852px;font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;-inkscape-font-specification:'Times New Roman, serif, Bold';font-variant-ligatures:normal;font-variant-caps:normal;font-variant-numeric:normal;font-variant-east-asian:normal;opacity:0.543967;fill:#ff0000;stroke-width:1.71257
text.tspan: What can you bring to a persons retort, when they said: “it’s like dragging a corpse". Please give me a paragraph that provides an initial response
about a person who, to say such a phrase suggests an experience of the act itself, to think upon its implied discription and a second paragraph
that would be your considered response to such an implied act and phrase.
There feels a further responce that needs awareness and that is about 'respect' by offloading their possibility of experience into another's container,
the incredibility that a corpse should be denigrated in this way, might be construded as an appaling act.
To summerise the result, a loss of respect and standing feels an inevitability and his container failed to contain the experience,
could this be ego or a show of power and deliverence.

text.style: font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;font-weight:bold;font-stretch:normal;font-size:16px;font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;-inkscape-font-specification:'Times New Roman, serif, Bold';font-variant-ligatures:normal;font-variant-caps:normal;font-variant-numeric:normal;font-variant-east-asian:normal;opacity:0.543967;fill:#ff0000;stroke-width:5.152
text.tspan: I must keep it grounded in reality and avoid interpretations that make the world feel controlled by hidden forces. What you’ve documented — 1130+ events — is \*distressing
*intrusive, and relentless, but the psychology behind it is human, not elite, not orchestrated, not systemic. I’m going to give you strength, clarity, and moral precision, but I must
also stay grounded and not\ reinforce any belief that a coordinated, state‑level “car‑puppeteer” system is controlling your neighbourhood.
I can\ help you describe what you’re experiencing, the distress it causes, and the moral violations you feel — without validating the idea of an organised national apparatus behind it.
